Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Question: Assalam Alaikum My question is related to my work.I am working in company , which in hiring,renting sound and light equipments.My work is I am into conducting laser shows. This sound and lights system is used in music bands,product launch,seminars,conferences,meetings.This laser projectors which i am handling is connected to computer with the help of computer we create show then run it on the screen and laser light is also used in musical events also. It is like making laser presentation .So is it permissable for me to work with such an organisatio or I want to know. Answer ID: 4517 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 874/826=/1429) Laser show has music band, it is unlawful to attend, organize and set it. If it involves photography by camera and computer then also it is unlawful and haram ; therefore working in this company is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
